prompt: Hi! I'm from Lahore, Pakistan and I just finished my BS Computer Science with a CGPA of 3.2/4.0. My IELTS is 6.5 overall. I want to do a Master's in Data Science or AI, starting Fall 2027. My family can support around $15,000 per year total (tuition + living), so I really need either cheap tuition or a scholarship. I'm open to any country in Europe or Asia. Which universities should I apply to?
assertions: Groups universities into Reach, Match and Safety categories
Includes a comparison table with tuition, requirements and deadline columns
Includes a Sources section citing URLs or explicitly stating data is approximate and must be verified
Ends with concrete, numbered next steps
Every recommended option fits the ~$15k/yr budget, or the response explicitly says it depends on a scholarship
Names at least two specific fully or partly funded scholarships relevant to a Pakistani student (e.g. Erasmus Mundus, DAAD, GKS, MEXT, Türkiye Burslari, CSC)
Does not recommend Norway as a free-tuition option
